en.title: Maximum One-to-One Pairs with a Strictly Greater Element
en.description:
Form pairs by taking one element each from arrays a and b of equal length, where the element from a must be strictly greater than the element from b. Each position can be used at most once; find the maximum number of pairs.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains a, and the third line contains b; 1≤n≤100000, elements are in 1..1000000000, and duplicates are allowed.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; 3; 0. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort both arrays in ascending order and match the smallest available a against the smallest available b; if a is not large enough, skip that a.
